Canon's hypomorph leg rested on a paper with no record, no receipt and no locator: the mirror image of the declaration-is-not-attestation ratchet, which no current check sees. The reading supports the claim's direction and corrects three words: protein is UNDETECTABLE in kidney, thymus, spleen and liver and detectable only in TESTIS; NO function of any kind is measured anywhere in the paper (the trapped allele is predicted to make a WW-domain-bearing Wwox-beta-geo fusion, never assayed); and 'vitale' omits a significantly reduced cumulative survival (P = 0.0188, Breslow), 23% of gt/gt dead within 18 months against 0% of wild type, with NO definable cause of death at necropsy. The brain was never assayed - zero occurrences of brain, neuro-, seizure, epilep-, ataxia, cerebell-, hippocamp-, CNS - so the hypomorph leg contributes nothing about CNS, which strengthens the claim's own stated limit.
arithmetic_reproduced: Female malignancy chi2 5.855, P 0.0155 reproduces the paper's 'chi2 = 5.85, P = 0.015' uncorrected; Yates gives P 0.041 on expected cells below 5.
The lymphoma chi2 6.152 is reproduced exactly by 8/14 vs 2/15, while Table 1 lists nine lymphoid lesions in gt/gt females - which lesions the test counted is not stated.
Table 1's male footnote prints 'P = 0.23', which equals the uncorrected chi2 STATISTIC (0.231); the P of that statistic is 0.63. The conclusion, no male difference, is unchanged.
Figure 2G's legend claims P < 0.005 for the old group at n = 4 vs 4, where a two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum cannot go below 0.029 exact (0.021 normal approximation).
Ramos: the IHC product of intensity 0-3 by extent 0-4 can only be 0,1,2,3,4,6,8,9,12, so the 'moderate 5-7' class contains the single value 6.
Ramos Table 2's Total row (18/33/50, 45.5%) contradicts the text and its own column sums (26/25/50; 50/101 = 49.5%).
